description: This Java class defines a custom password strength validator implementing the ConstraintValidator interface, used to validate passwords based on a strength metric. It utilizes the ZXCVBN library to evaluate password robustness and enforces a minimum strength score as specified by an annotation parameter.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidator
classes.description: Custom validator class for checking password strength, implementing the ConstraintValidator interface.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the password strength requirement from the annotation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the password by measuring its strength and comparing it to the required minimum score.
